title: Tower 28 to host first-ever pop-up with Sephora to celebrate its community
summary: The beauty brand by Amy Liu is hosting beach-themed pop-up, Sensitive Club, in Venice, California, this month, claiming to be a ‘love letter’ to its fans and ‘an exercise in community-building’

extraction.key_fact: 타워 이십팔이 세포라와 함께 커뮤니티를 기념하는 최초의 해변 테마 팝업스토어를 캘리포니아 베니스에서 개최한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Tower 28 to host first-ever pop-up with Sephora to celebrate its community
